description:
Arsenic soap was once sold as a “miracle” beauty product, but the truth was far from glamorous. In the late 1800s, companies claimed it could brighten skin and erase blemishes, while quietly ignoring the dangerous side effects. From chronic poisoning to unexpected hair loss, this so called beauty treatment left people with far more problems than it solved.
